verdict.rationale: Pulumi has a dedicated, documented import workflow: `pulumi import` adopts an existing cloud resource into state and generates the corresponding program code to manage it, and `pulumi preview --import-file` can bulk-generate an import file/code for many resources at once. This directly matches the platform-engineer story of bringing existing resources under management with matching generated code, and is presented as a first-class, supported feature across all Pulumi languages.
